basic_info.description: Lovingly maintained tunnel entrance home in a prime location, just off the Noriega Street shopping corridor. Situated on a deep level lot, this home has a wonderful floor-plan and an abundance of period charm that is apparent from the moment you step into the foyer. The light filled living room has recessed ceilings with plaster detailing, a wood burning fireplace with ornate surround and parquet wood flooring. The dining room is open to a well appointed kitchen with abundant cabinetry, quartz counters and stainless appliances. Bedrooms overlook the deep rear yard and have views of the ocean. The main level bathroom has both a shower stall and tub. On the lower level you will find an en-suite bedroom and access to a low maintenance yard with a concrete patio and mature trees. The garage can accommodate parking, storage and expansion potential. This vibrant location is within walking distance of an abundance of local eateries and has access to a multitude of transportation options.
